stops.title: The city addressed
stops.text: A great port city of Roman Asia, famous for the temple of Artemis, where Paul taught for about three years.

stops.title: A neighboring church
stops.text: Tychicus also carried a letter to Colossae, which shares much with Ephesians. This stop is not named in Ephesians itself.

stops.title: Where Paul is probably held
stops.text: Paul calls himself "an ambassador in chains." Rome is the traditional place of his imprisonment, but the letter does not say.
